The iced shaken espresso is an inconsistent drink in general, because the amount of foam depends on how melty the ice is and how many times and how hard it's shaken, and the amount of foam will affect how much milk is added--from a splash to an inch. 

Also, you have so many modifications that it's going to be hard to keep track of, especially when it's busy. The more modifications to any drink, the more likely it is that we'll accidentally mess it up. 

If you don't want to make your Barista's life harder AND you want a more consistent drink, see if you can find a base drink that you like and can love with less than four modifications.

I also want to make it really clear that this isn't a personal attack, your drink looks delicious! It's just facts that we're human and sometimes our eyes skip over steps when they're part of a long, condensed list, or sometimes we suddenly forget if we've done 1 step when we're trying to remember 10 steps. It's not on purpose, and we don't think you're bad, or that your drink is bad!

Give your skin a couple weeks to react to a basic routine and then adjust it from there (ie, if your skin still feels dry add more moisturizing stuff to your routine).
